name: mensa-karlsruhe
description: Access daily meal plans from Studierendenwerk Karlsruhe canteens. Use this skill to help users find what's being served at various university canteens (Mensen) in Karlsruhe, including prices, dietary options (vegetarian, vegan), and nutritional information.

commands.description: Get a list of all available canteens with their IDs and names
examples: Welche Mensen gibt es in Karlsruhe?

commands.description: Get today's meal plan, optionally filtered by canteen
examples: Was gibt es heute in der Mensa?
What's on the menu today at Mensa Adenauerring?

commands.description: Get meal plan for a specific date
examples: Was gibt es morgen in der Mensa?

commands.description: Search for meals containing a keyword

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of days to search ahead (default: 3, max: 7)

examples: Find all vegan meals this week

commands.description: Get explanation of food additives and nutritional classifiers
examples: Was bedeutet das 'VG' bei den Gerichten?

prompt_templates.daily_summary: Gib mir eine Zusammenfassung des heutigen Essensangebots in der Mensa Am Adenauerring. Liste die Hauptgerichte mit Preisen auf.
prompt_templates.vegetarian_options: Finde alle vegetarischen Gerichte für heute und morgen.
prompt_templates.cheapest_vegan: Was ist das günstigste vegane Gericht heute?
prompt_templates.compare_canteens: Vergleiche das Angebot der Mensa Moltke mit der Mensa am Adenauerring.
